sample_unit: semi-structured interviews with developers, digital ethics experts, and digital health specialists

links.outcome: Stakeholder perceptions of accountability for AI mental health app errors in practice
links.effect: Interviewees described accountability for AI-driven mental health apps as fragmented in practice (qualitative theme; no quantitative data).
